top_choice_rationale: GLP-1 is a complete arc from gut-hormone physiology and the truncated active peptide through receptor biology to drugs with large, independently confirmed benefits on glycaemia, weight and cardiovascular and renal outcomes after two decades. The three-laureate allocation (Drucker, Holst, Mojsov) reflects distinct documented contributions to the discovery core, and the citation scope is bounded to physiology and the active form enabling incretin-based therapy. No award is clearly inferior given the maturity of this work.
